style.backgroundSystem: alternating full-bleed deep-green gradient bands #2E6B4E and clean white or light-grey panels #FFFFFF/#F3F4F2; floor ledges trimmed by a thin warm metal line; a fabric drape prop in muted brick #A0524D appears only in hero set dressing
style.iconSystem: thin-line white icons on rounded-corner green gradient tiles; single stroke weight, minimal
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio key from the front-left with gentle fill and a subtle rim, soft contact shadows under every product, no harsh specular hotspots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool premium tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep green #2E6B4E, pure white #FFFFFF, light grey #F3F4F2, charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one fresh green accent #4FA97F, with a muted brick #A0524D fabric prop allowed only in hero set dressing; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines with clean English micro-labels; alternating full-bleed green gradient bands and clean white or light-grey panels; bright soft diffused studio lighting from the front-left with a subtle rim and soft contact shadows; consistent thin-line white icons on rounded-corner green gradient tiles; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product reads as a pair of compact bean-shaped true-wireless earbuds with a small oval charging case; stable centered placement, consistent scale within each shot, soft grounding contact shadow, hovering renders must keep a soft drop shadow connecting to the surface below
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless color bands, light stone-like floor ledge, matte white card surfaces
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for short Chinese headlines with clean English micro-labels; short headlines only, no dense body text
